findings.evidence: `grep -rl 'SpinDensityC|transversity|deltaQ|deltaG' code/EpsilonEridani` → only `PDF/Positivity.lean`, `Matrix/PosSemidef.lean`, `Inference/Gluon.lean`, `Inference/JointHelicity.lean` (all listed as pre-existing upstream material in README.md:224–249), plus the new file. `Glob code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/**/*.lean` shows `Polarized/{Basic,SumRules,Kinematics}.lean` only — no Layer 0.2 tensor module. The new file's imports are `Mathlib.Data.Int.Order.Basic`, `Mathlib.Data.Set.Defs`, `Mathlib.Order.Interval.Set.Defs`.
findings.fix: Land Layer 1.1–1.4 (at minimum 1.1 and 1.4, which define the transversity object whose gluon analogue is being excluded) before this, or state in the description which open PR supplies them; then connect `helicityChanges` to that transversity material rather than shipping it standalone.
findings.issue: Layer 1.5 is the final subsection of a cumulative layer (README.md:18, and Layer 1's Dependencies at README.md:637 require Layer 0), but its prerequisite stages are absent on main: Layer 0.2 (the antisymmetric tensor / `IsG1G2Decomposition`), 0.3, 0.4, and Layer 1.1 (`SpinDensityC`), 1.2 (`Δq`, `ΔΣ`, parton-model `g₁`), 1.3, 1.4 (transversity from the double-flip entry, chiral-oddness). Only Layer 0.1 (`PolarizedKinematics`) has landed. The module consequently imports only Mathlib and mentions no transversity, gluon or matrix-element object from the library.

summary: The roadmap claim is exact — Layer 1.5's two named statements, matching the roadmap's own `Suggested.lean` definition verbatim — and the PR is a single topic. But it delivers the last subsection of Layer 1 while Layers 0.2–0.4 and 1.1–1.4 are absent from main, so the counting fact lands with no transversity, spin-density or tensor object in the library for it to attach to.
